results.title: The Tower
results.overview: RELIGION OF MESS.  A kaleidoscopic tapestry of colorful characters collide in a small Iowa town. Runaway children make a movie, aging idealists hatch a dangerous plan, aimless townie girls get into mischief, a mysterious mother digs for buried treasure, and shirtless man ponders the meaning of the town’s towers. Spooky, serendipitous resonances bubble up between stories where people play themselves in fictionalized as well as real life scenarios. In a world in crisis, filmmaking itself becomes a form of coping and celebration.

results.title: Kill The DJ
results.overview: Diamond, a fierce underground DJ, gets an impromptu gig at a mysterious nightclub owned by the suspicious Miss Linda. However upon arrival, Diamond’s next big DJ set becomes a fight for survival in a nightclub that devolves into a house of horrors.

results.title: Gasmask
results.overview: Fifteen years after the fall of civilization, the last remnants of humanity are left to survive in a world without electricity. When a solar-powered generator opens up new frontiers for discovery, our narrator starts recording his memories using an old phone, and a group of artists — a musician, a storyteller, and a dancer — utilize the electricity to bring their creative impulses to life. Suddenly, members of a generation shaped by the apocalypse are able to scavenge through old smartphones like relics of a vanished civilization, discovering pictures of cats and fragments of forgotten music from a world they never knew.

results.title: You Don't Know My Name
results.overview: Separated from his incarcerated mother at birth, the filmmaker searches for her identity and uncovers deep ancestral bloodlines. As he gets closer to this life-altering truth, he navigates his way through systems designed to keep him in the dark.

results.title: Guan Feng
results.overview: This film documents Taoyuan Daxi’s all-female Shengjiang troupe, founded in 2003, exploring women’s entry into the traditionally male-dominated tradition and opening new possibilities for gender, the body, and queer publicness in folk religion. image curation and cultural practices. In recent years, she has explored local Taiwanese culture.

results.title: Times of Innocence
results.overview: Inspired by the memories of Walter Lima Jr., this film traces the history of Brazilian cinema through the many adaptations (both completed and abandoned) of Inocência, a classic of Brazilian literature.

results.title: Ney Behind the Masks
results.overview: Follows Ney Matogrosso as he prepares for the parade of Imperatriz Leopoldinense, transforming Carnival into a space for exploring identity, freedom, and mortality. Amid rehearsals and significant encounters, the film reveals an intimate side of Ney as he revisits the choices that have shaped his journey, prompting reflection on the masks we wear throughout our lives and the courage it takes to remain true to who we are.

results.title: Dead Crows
results.overview: A paranoid teenager, at home alone, becomes haunted by the spirit of a boy that he killed, and the two try to find absolution with one another.

results.title: Shine!
results.overview: Davide has a dream: to become a professional wrestler. For him, it’s a full-blown obsession - nothing can stop him. Except for a few details: he doesn’t have Hulk Hogan’s muscles, he’s still in high school, and most of all... he’s terrified of jumping out of the ring.

results.title: Beware of Dog
results.overview: After calling a number she finds on a bathroom wall, a young woman's search for intimacy leads her down a highway of strange desire.

results.title: Unexpressed
results.overview: Anya, who has been living in Germany since the beginning of the full-scale invasion, returns to Ukraine and visits her ex-boyfriend at his photo lab. She already knows there is another woman in his life. As they spend the evening together, what has remained unspoken between them slowly comes to the surface. When Anya tries to leave, he stops her, and for a brief moment they fall back into a familiar intimacy, despite everything that now stands between them.

results.title: The Way Out
results.overview: The Way Out drops you right into the action across the globe, from heavy Alaskan spine lines to local backyard laps in Whistler. It represents a path toward total freedom, whether tracking Hoji, Chris Rubens, and Mark Abma across the iconic Swiss Alps, or capturing breakout skier Lucy Leishman storming through Japan’s deep powder with three legendary freeskiers. The verdict is simple: the soul of skiing isn’t dead. It’s alive and well, wherever the snow is falling.

results.title: Reminiscence
results.overview: After losing his girlfriend in a car crash, a teenage boy recalls old memories.

results.title: Jet Lag: The Game – Japanorama Finale
results.original_title: Jet Lag: The Game – Japanorama Finale
results.overview: Watch the conclusion of Jet Lag: The Game's biggest season ever with this screening of the final two, action-packed episodes as Tom & Adam race Sam & Ben to the top of Hokkaido.

results.title: Revenge of the Celluloid
results.overview: In the underbelly of a monochromatic world lurks a mad embalmer conducting a sinister experiment. A generative machine disguised as a moving picture show turns children into mindless ghouls. One woman aims to put an end to M. Balm's cinema of horrors.

results.title: If I Only Had Wings
results.overview: As graduation nears, Kaelan, a teenager tries to make sense of his friendships, family struggles, and what comes next.

results.title: Bea Arthur: The Documentary
results.overview: An intimate portrait of the actress celebrated for "Maude," "The Golden Girls" and "Mame." Built around a previously unseen interview conducted by producer and director Dan Watt, the film traces Arthur’s path from The New School and New York theatre to Broadway and television. Through Arthur’s own reflections and interviews with colleagues and close friends, the documentary looks beyond the tall, hilariously brassy public persona to reveal a woman who was also sensitive, vulnerable, compassionate and deeply committed to the people and causes she valued.

results.title: Sheriff Labrador: Save the Mango Festival
results.original_title: 啦咘啦哆警长之巡逻行动：保卫芒果节启动，全速出发
results.overview: Sheriff Labrador and his team save the Mango Festival in Mango Village by solving a series of chaotic sabotage incidents and emergencies.
